headlines.headline: Jio Platforms listing in less than 24 hours: History in the making; what Akash Ambani told investors
headlines.summary: The Jio Platforms' issue became the first among India’s mega IPOs to achieve full subscription within just 100 minutes of opening and the first global offering to cross the one-crore application mark.

headlines.headline: Reliance Industries awards ‘Mega’ order to VA Tech Wabag for Jamnagar plant; check how shares are performing
headlines.summary: VA Tech Wabag shares jumped after the company announced that it had secured a ‘Mega’ order from Reliance Industries (RIL) for the design, engineering, supply, installation, pre-commissioning, commissioning and performance guarantee test run (PGTR) of a desalination plant at Jamnagar, Gujarat.

headlines.headline: L&T bags Dhaka Metro order worth up to ₹10,000 crore; here’s how stock is faring ahead of Q2 earnings
headlines.summary: L&T’s transportation infrastructure business vertical secured major design and build orders for two key systems packages of the Dhaka Mass Rapid Transit Development Project.

headlines.headline: L&T Q2 results: Revenue could see double digit growth driven by new order inflow and execution; Key focus on West Asia crisis and its impact
headlines.summary: Larsen & Toubro will announce its Q2FY27 results on Tuesday, October 27. Experts expect double-digit revenue growth, but net profit could stay flat as geopolitical issues in West Asia weigh on project execution and margins.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50 and SENSEX open in red on Tuesday; Reliance shares decline ahead of Jio Platforms IPO listing
headlines.summary: The pullback was largely driven by index heavyweight stocks like HDFC Bank (-0.45%), Sriram Finance (-0.6%), HCL Technologies (-0.8%), and Infosys(-2.4%). Meanwhile, the index breadth for NIFTY50 tilted towards losers, with 34 stocks opening in red, 11 in green, and 5 unchanged.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms listing: How Reliance Industries and other group stocks are faring ahead of mega IPO debut on October 28
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms' IPO closed with bids for 22.19 times the shares on offer, as total demand across the public issue and anchor investor placement crossed ₹7.4 lakh crore and applications approached a world-beating 1.39 crore in an unprecedented response to the Reliance Industries-backed digital services company.

headlines.headline: Bharat Electronics, HAL, BEML: Defence stocks rally as Centre clears ₹2.12 lakh crore procurement proposals
headlines.summary: The list includes light multi-role helicopters, long-range kamikaze drones, and radars, aimed at strengthening the armed forces' combat capabilities.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms IPO listing: Know how Reliance Industries turned ₹1,000 investment in 1977 into ₹53 lakh in 2026
headlines.summary: Jio IPO allotment will be announced late evening on October 26, followed by listing on October 28. The Jio Platforms IPO received overwhelming response from investors, with the issue being subscribed 22 times overall. Few investors know that the IPO of its parent company, Reliance Industries, also received a similar response back in 1977. Here is how ₹1,000 invested in the Reliance IPO turned into ₹53 lakh in 2026.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 27: Waaree Energies, Paytm, L&T, REC, Tata Consumer Products, Maruti, JBM Auto
headlines.summary: Paytm reported an over 10-fold rise in profit after tax (PAT) to ₹225 crore in the September quarter (Q2 FY27), from ₹21 crore a year ago, on a reported basis, marking its sixth consecutive profitable quarter.

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 snap 4-day losing streak on short covering led by Reliance, Kotak Bank
headlines.summary: Reliance Industries, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Eternal, Bharti Airtel, ICICI Bank, Adani Ports, ITC and Larsen & Toubro were top movers in the SENSEX.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Kotak Bank report higher Q2 profits despite margin pressure
headlines.summary: All the four banks reported growth in net profit and net interest income at the same time they also announced an improvement in asset quality at the end of September quarter.

headlines.headline: Infosys shares fall 4% on conservative revenue growth outlook; focus on muted QoQ earnings
headlines.summary: IT major Infosys shares declined 4% at the opening bell as investors focused on the conservative guidance for FY27 amid the company's management citing heightened volatility in the market.

headlines.headline: SENSEX plunges over 500 points, NIFTY50 below 22,400; Infosys falls after cutting revenue guidance
headlines.summary: IT heavyweight Infosys dropped after it slashed the revenue growth guidance for the current financial year.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 26: Senco Gold, Infosys, Coforge, Paytm, ITC Hotels, JBM Auto, JSW Steel, Dr Reddy's
headlines.summary: Infosys on Friday reported a 6.2% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹7,823 crore for the second quarter ended September 30, driven by an increasing share of AI-led projects in its revenue mix.

headlines.headline: GIFT NIFTY indicates positive opening for markets amid drop in crude despite weak Asian cues
headlines.summary: Asian shares were trading on a subdued note as investors awaited monetary decisions from major central banks due later this week and an array of corporate earnings.
